'''''A2 Tow''''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] that was picking up and delivering supplies [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|Flagship]] the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|Protector]] during his attempt to defect to the Alliance.
